rule1: 1- The application works by generating a custom code that you can share, and when others scan it on their phones, they are directed directly to a page containing your professional information and social links, which facilitates communication and learning about your experiences.
rule2: 2- Once you create your account, you can enter your professional data, a profile, and links to your social or professional platforms such as LinkedIn and Behance, to be automatically linked to your unique code that represents your digital identity.
rule3: 3- Whether you're a designer, developer, or working in any other field, the app provides you with a smart and quick way to share your professional identity by simply scanning your code, enhancing your chances of meeting people and building professional relationships with ease.
